svg.title: Layered architecture with SNR checkpoints, gates, failure modes, axioms, and toasts between every layer
svg.desc: Five node layers stack vertically. Between each pair of layers sits a checkpoint band containing: an SNR bar, a gate label, the primary failure mode, an axiom, and a toast indicator (green pass, red fail). No layer communicates past its adjacent checkpoint.

g.text: immutable · event bus · append-only store · clock

svg.text: axiom: every event has a uuid, ts, causedBy — or it is dropped
axiom: no module writes a table it did not declare in its COBALT manifest
axiom: local agent first; API agent only when local exhausted or failed 3×
axiom: UI is a read-only reflection of state — it never writes, never routes
